name: Unicode CLDR 49 emoji annotations (English, Malayalam)
attribution: Copyright © 1991-2026 Unicode, Inc. Emoji keywords and names from the Unicode Common Locale Data Repository (CLDR) 49, common/annotations/en.xml and ml.xml, distributed under the Unicode License v3.
verdict_reason: Permissive, like the Unicode emoji data: the CLDR data files are under the Unicode License v3, which allows modified copies with the notice, carried in the app's About screen.
used_for: Emoji suggestions in the bar: the one-word keywords and names (tts) of each emoji, lowercased, compiled by data/pipeline/emoji_data.py into apps/ios/KeyboardExtension/Emoji/emoji-words.txt; and the emoji panel's search: every word of each name and keyword, into emoji-search.txt. No Manglish: CLDR has no romanised Malayalam.
